FAQ

Common Questions

What is Sudo?

Sudo is a dedicated music player designed around one thing: listening to music.

How does the reservation work?

A reservation secures your place in the first production batch. A $50 deposit is charged when you reserve and will be applied toward the final purchase price.

Is the $50 deposit refundable?

Yes. Your reservation deposit is fully refundable until you complete your purchase.

When will Sudo ship?

Sudo is expected to ship at the beginning of Q4 2027. Reservation holders will receive updates along the way.

How much will Sudo cost?

The expected retail price is $249. Final pricing will be confirmed before reservation holders are asked to complete their purchase, and your $50 reservation deposit will be credited toward the total.

Where will Sudo be available?

Reservations will initially be available in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand. You can join the waitlist if Sudo isn’t available in your country yet.

Can I change my color later?

Yes. You’ll have an opportunity to confirm your color and shipping details before your order enters production.

What happens after I reserve?

You’ll receive a confirmation email and your place in the first batch. We’ll keep you updated on development, production, and when it’s time to complete your order.
